searchText: Looks like the final drop after stabilization was ~5% post merge on Prater. Pretty good. Things are seeming more stable now, so I guess this means we are looking good so far with the Goerli merge? Yes, participation rate is almost recovered to the level that we had before the Merge gm, dono if this is the right place to ask what is the Bellatrix upgrade? is the merge a 2 step upgrade? Flashbots is now censoring all sanctioned addresses. If mevboost and fb relay gets major adoption, a bunch of txs will get censored afaik fb relay will be the default relay for any mev boost user. yup and IIUC clients arn't checking the value of their own block vs the MEV-Boost block, so its free censorship why do they do it? Shouldn't it be a problem for the entity proposing the block to not include sanctioned addresses? Bellatrix is the consensus client's Merge prep step. Nothing visible will change with it, but it needs to happen before The Merge can happen. In the scenario that the original TTD is overridden, and the merge instead happens after some TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH, how and when is the value of TBH set? Are there any definitive discussions or resources on this? In the same scenario, is it guaranteed that the "new" TTD is less than the original TTD? with the Flashbots relay going open source hopefully someone in another jurisdiction can set up another relay that defies the sanctions Bellatrix is the consensus layer client upgrade. The Merge requires consensus layer clients to upgrade to Bellatrix (September 6), the execution layer clients to upgrade to Paris and then the transition to PoS happens when we hit TTD. See: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/08/12/finalized-no-36/ Does anyone have a sense of how miners will behave in these remaining weeks? My assumption is that ETH prices will be high enough due to narrative/speculative reasons to keep them willingly mining the chain right up to/close to the needed TTD.

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content:
Bellatrix is the consensus layer client upgrade.  

The Merge requires consensus layer clients to upgrade to Bellatrix (September 6), the execution layer clients to upgrade to Paris and then the transition to PoS happens when we hit TTD.

See: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/08/12/finalized-no-36/
